# Incremental Ticket Export (Time-Based)

## Prerequisites

- You must be an **Admin** (Allowed For: *Admins*).
- The `start_time` you provide must be **at least one minute in the past**.

## Method

`GET`

## URL

`https://{{OAUTH_REQUEST_PAYLOAD.formData.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN}}.zendesk.com/api/v2/incremental/tickets`

## Description

Returns tickets that changed since the specified `start_time` using **time-based incremental export**. Results can include tickets updated by the system, and the endpoint compares `start_time` against each ticket’s `generated_timestamp` (not `updated_at`), which can cause tickets with `updated_at` earlier than `start_time` to appear in results.

## Enforcement Rules

- **When executing, send Query Parameters in the URL as query parameters, not in the body.**
- This endpoint has **no path parameters**.
- `start_time` is **required** and **must be at least one minute in the past**.
- The endpoint may return tickets whose `updated_at` is earlier than `start_time` because filtering is based on `generated_timestamp`.

## Required Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---:|---|
| `start_time` | integer | The time to start the incremental export from (Unix timestamp). **Must be at least one minute in the past**. Example: `1332034771`. |

## Optional Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `support_type_scope` | string | Lists tickets by support type. Possible values: `"all"`, `"agent"`, `"ai_agent"`. Default: `"agent"`. |

## Response

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer | Number of tickets returned in this page of results. |
| `end_of_stream` | boolean | Whether there are more results to fetch. |
| `end_time` | integer | A Unix timestamp to use as the next `start_time` value. |
| `next_page` | string | URL for the next page of results. |
| `tickets` | array | Array of ticket objects. |

### Ticket Object Fields (as provided)

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tickets[].allow_attachments` | boolean | Permission for agents to add attachments to a comment. Defaults to `true`. |
| `tickets[].allow_channelback` | boolean | `false` if channelback is disabled, `true` otherwise. Only applicable for channels framework ticket. |
| `tickets[].assignee_email` | string | Write only. Email address of the agent to assign the ticket to. |
| `tickets[].assignee_id` | integer | The agent currently assigned to the ticket. |
| `tickets[].attribute_value_ids` | array of integer | Write only. IDs of attribute values to associate with the ticket. |
| `tickets[].brand_id` | integer | Brand ID associated with the ticket. |
| `tickets[].collaborator_ids` | array of integer | IDs of users currently CC’ed on the ticket. |
| `tickets[].collaborators` | array of object | POST requests only. Users to add as CCs when creating a ticket (`email`, `name`). |
| `tickets[].comment` | object | Write only. Adds a comment to the ticket. Ticket can contain up to 5000 comments total; exceeding this yields a 422 error when adding more comments. |
| `tickets[].created_at` | string | When this record was created. |
| `tickets[].custom_fields` | array of object | Custom fields (`id`, `value`). |
| `tickets[].custom_status_id` | integer | Custom ticket status id. |
| `tickets[].description` | string | Read-only first comment on the ticket. When creating a ticket, use `comment` to set the description. |
| `tickets[].due_at` | string | Due date for type `"task"` (ISO 8601). |
| `tickets[].email_cc_ids` | array of integer | IDs of agents/end users CC’ed on the ticket (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled). |
| `tickets[].email_ccs` | object | Write only. Objects to add/delete email CCs (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled). |
| `tickets[].encoded_id` | string | Encoded string representing the ticket’s unique identifier. |
| `tickets[].external_id` | string | External ID to link tickets to local records. |
| `tickets[].follower_ids` | array of integer | IDs of agents following the ticket (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled). |
| `tickets[].followers` | object | Write only. Objects to add/delete followers (ignored if CCs and followers not enabled). |
| `tickets[].followup_ids` | array of integer | IDs of followups created from this ticket (visible once ticket is closed). |
| `tickets[].forum_topic_id` | integer | Topic in Zendesk Web portal the ticket originated from (Web portal deprecated). |
| `tickets[].from_messaging_channel` | boolean | If `true`, the ticket’s `via` type is a messaging channel. |
| `tickets[].generated_timestamp` | integer | Unix timestamp of most accurate “last updated” time; updated for all updates including system updates. |
| `tickets[].group_id` | integer | Group the ticket is assigned to. |
| `tickets[].has_incidents` | boolean | `true` if problem ticket has one or more incidents linked; otherwise `false`. |
| `tickets[].id` | integer | Ticket ID. |
| `tickets[].is_public` | boolean | `true` if any comments are public, else `false`. |
| `tickets[].macro_id` | integer | Write only. Macro ID to be recorded in the ticket audit. |
| `tickets[].macro_ids` | array of integer | POST requests only. Macro IDs to record in the ticket audit. |
| `tickets[].metadata` | object | Write only. Metadata for the audit (in audit object, data is in `metadata.custom`). |
| `tickets[].organization_id` | integer | Organization of the requester (must be associated with requester). |
| `tickets[].priority` | string | Possible values: `urgent`, `high`, `normal`, `low`. |
| `tickets[].problem_id` | integer | For type `"incident"`, ID of the linked problem ticket. |
| `tickets[].raw_subject` | string | Dynamic content placeholder if present, otherwise the subject value. |
| `tickets[].recipient` | string | Original recipient email address of the ticket. |
| `tickets[].requester` | object | Write only. Requester object (used when creating a ticket with a new requester). |
| `tickets[].requester_id` | integer | The user who requested this ticket. *(Marked required in the ticket schema.)* |
| `tickets[].safe_update` | boolean | Write only. Collision protection when `update_stamp` included; `false` has same effect as `true`. Omit to force updates to not be safe. |
| `tickets[].satisfaction_rating` | object | Satisfaction rating object (free-form map). |
| `tickets[].sharing_agreement_ids` | array of integer | IDs of sharing agreements used for this ticket. |
| `tickets[].status` | string | Possible values: `new`, `open`, `pending`, `hold`, `solved`, `closed`. |
| `tickets[].subject` | string | Subject field value. |
| `tickets[].submitter_id` | integer | User who submitted the ticket. |
| `tickets[].tags` | array of string | Tags applied to the ticket (set tag behavior overwrites and replaces existing tags unless specified otherwise). |
| `tickets[].ticket_form_id` | integer | Ticket form ID (Enterprise only). |
| `tickets[].type` | string | Possible values: `problem`, `incident`, `question`, `task`. |
| `tickets[].updated_at` | string | When record last got updated; updated only if the update generates a ticket event. |
| `tickets[].updated_stamp` | string | Write only. Datetime of last update received from API (see `safe_update`). |
| `tickets[].url` | string | API URL of this ticket. |
| `tickets[].via.channel` | string | How the ticket/event was created (examples: `web`, `mobile`, `rule`, `system`). |
| `tickets[].via.source` | object | Source object (free-form map). |
| `tickets[].via_followup_source_id` | integer | POST requests only. ID of a closed ticket when creating a follow-up ticket. |
| `tickets[].via_id` | integer | Write only. Via ID (see Via object reference). |
| `tickets[].voice_comment` | object | Write only. Voice comment object (see voicemail ticket docs). |

## Sideloading

- Supported; see **Tickets sideloads** in Zendesk docs.
- For performance reasons, `last_audits` sideloads **aren’t supported**.

## Sample Request

```bash
curl -i --request GET \
  --url 'https://{{OAUTH_REQUEST_PAYLOAD.formData.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN}}.zendesk.com/api/v2/incremental/tickets?start_time=1332034771'
```

## Example Usage

### Example 1: Basic incremental export

```bash
curl -sS \
  'https://{{OAUTH_REQUEST_PAYLOAD.formData.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN}}.zendesk.com/api/v2/incremental/tickets?start_time=1332034771'
```

### Example 2: Include only AI agent tickets (time-based)

```bash
curl -sS \
  'https://{{OAUTH_REQUEST_PAYLOAD.formData.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN}}.zendesk.com/api/v2/incremental/tickets?start_time=1332034771&support_type_scope=ai_agent'
```

## Behavior

1. Validates `start_time` (must be at least one minute old).
2. Compares `start_time` to each ticket’s `generated_timestamp` (not `updated_at`).
3. Returns a page of matching tickets plus pagination metadata (`end_time`, `next_page`, `end_of_stream`).

## Notes

- The endpoint can return tickets with `updated_at` earlier than `start_time` due to filtering on `generated_timestamp`.
- Results can include tickets updated by the system.
- Cursor-based pagination is mentioned as an alternative in the scraped content, but is a different endpoint (“Incremental Ticket Export, Cursor Based”).
